nodes.name: FULL_RULES_GAME_AND_STATE_DEFINED
nodes.proposition: The weak-solution game, full state identity, claim actions and terminal semantics are unambiguously specified.

nodes.name: SMALL_FULL_RULES_TRUTH_ANCHORS
nodes.proposition: Exact full-rule W/D truth and exact DEAD semantics are demonstrated on small replayed reference arenas.
evidence: G12 same-colour K+2B vs K DEAD

nodes.name: RESTRICTED_HIGHER_TREE_TRUTH
nodes.proposition: Exact/replayed truth exists for selected restricted six-, seven- and eight-man arenas.

nodes.name: FINITE_GRAPH_COMPOSITION_CORE
nodes.proposition: Strict attractor, Branch/Hyperkernel and Filter-Pivot operations can compose or factor exact finite-game basins once exact targets/dependencies are supplied.

nodes.name: TRUSTED_COMPUTE_CERTIFICATE_AND_STORE
nodes.proposition: There is substantial deterministic solve/replay/certificate/store infrastructure, subject to the open G12-through-G13 distributed acceptance replay.

nodes.name: SCALABLE_TRUTH_DISCOVERY_OR_LIFT
nodes.proposition: A repeatable mechanism should lift lower exact truth through less restricted, materially higher domains with discovery cost substantially below near-complete enumeration.
evidence: R2 zero-label target/strategy discovery and hostile transfer audit
nodes.r1_note: Exact material-signature scaling and inherited target transfer survived at bounded scope; H2 falsified robust fixed-palette strategy transfer. Open edge narrowed to topology-adaptive proof discovery across opposing material.
nodes.r2_note: Zero-top-label target and strategy-program discovery succeeded with exact held-out opposing-bishop transfer and tiny residual raw truth, but accepted discovery cost exceeded full exact-truth acquisition (1.2780x) and the objects are conversion-dominated. Scalable favourable discovery remains unestablished.

nodes.name: BROAD_ENDGAME_BASIN_NETWORK
nodes.proposition: The programme should possess broad connected lower-tree basins covering diverse endgame/transition structures rather than isolated restricted arenas.

nodes.name: CERTIFIED_MIDDLEGAME_NETWORK
nodes.proposition: Certified basins should extend through materially richer middlegame structures with enough connectivity to receive start-reachable play.

nodes.name: START_REACHABLE_FORWARD_DOMAIN
nodes.proposition: A nontrivial domain rooted at the standard initial full state should be certified as legally START_REACHABLE under exact full-rule history semantics.
evidence: G11 reachable fuzz is only engineering evidence

nodes.name: START_TO_BASIN_CONNECTOR
nodes.proposition: Certified start-reachable play should intersect compatible certified middlegame/lower basins with exact state/history identity.

nodes.name: ALL_OPPONENT_REPLY_CLOSURE
nodes.proposition: For each certified White strategy choice on the start-connected route, every legal Black reply must remain in the proof or enter an already-certified non-loss basin.
evidence: Finite attractor semantics establish the logical closure rule only at restricted finite scope

nodes.name: INITIAL_POSITION_CERTIFICATE
nodes.proposition: A machine-checkable certificate rooted at the standard initial position should close every legal Black reply and establish White non-loss.

nodes.name: WHITE_NON_LOSS_THEOREM
nodes.proposition: The standard initial position has outcome WHITE_WIN or DRAW under perfect legal play.

edges.why: G12 instantiates full-rule semantics on small exact reference arenas.
G6–G8 repeatedly apply exact graph composition/factorization to restricted arenas.
G12 has producer/verifier replay; G14 store is engineering-only and the G13 distributed acceptance seam remains open.
G8 independently replays selected restricted truth; later G13/G14 infrastructure does not add chess truth.

R2 shows a bounded zero-top-label discovery mechanism can select exact proof objects over exact lower-material truth, but does not establish favorable multi-ascent discovery economics or a full-rule lift.

R1 established bounded exact scaling but fixed-palette failure; R2 then achieved exact zero-top-label target/strategy discovery with held-out opposing-material transfer, yet discovery cost exceeded complete truth acquisition and the arena remained conversion-rich. The edge stays OPEN.
Composition algebra can amplify known basins, but it does not supply or discover constituent basins; therefore it supports but does not close N05.
G16–G22 are intended to build broad truth/basin coverage if scalable lifting/discovery succeeds.
G29–G34 describe transition-rich and middlegame bridge work but no established mechanism guarantees the transition.
G35 is intended to build the start-position forward canonicalizer; G11 reachable fuzz is not a certificate.
No certified middlegame basin network currently exists to receive start play.
No certified intersection or entry edge from the start-reachable domain into a solved basin exists.
Existential/universal predecessor semantics are mathematically available, but global all-reply closure economics and discovery remain unproved.
A connector alone is insufficient unless every adversarial reply is closed.
No root-connected complete all-reply proof DAG exists.
If a valid machine-checkable initial-position certificate closes every legal Black reply under exact rules, White non-loss follows by definition.

routing_blocker.note: R0 did not repair this blocker.

required_separation.discovery_leverage: Mechanisms that reduce the cost of discovering truth/targets
required_separation.proof_certificate_compression: Mechanisms that compactly represent/replay already-established truth
required_separation.global_connectivity: Certified START_REACHABLE route and all-opponent-reply closure
